This in turn interferes with the ability to train at a high level, which impedes muscle development. Moreover, although training in the early recovery phase of EIMD does not seem to exacerbate muscle damage, it may interfere with the recovery process (143, 199). Taken as a whole, it can be speculated that a protocol that elicits a mild to moderate amount of damage may help to maximize the hypertrophic response. Considering that a ceiling effect slows the rate of hypertrophy as one gains training experience, EIMD may be particularly relevant to the anabolic response in well-trained people.
